# Scientific Requirements Checklist: Scientific Calculator

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, and consistency of scientific
calculator requirements for reviewer use.
**Created**: 2026-11-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command
based on the scientific calculator feature context.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality
review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the
requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied
for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are all supported scientific functions explicitly enumerated,
  including trigonometric, inverse trigonometric, logarithmic, root, factorial,
  reciprocal, and constant operations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003–FR-007]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are basic calculator capabilities that must be preserved during
  scientific conversion fully documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are parentheses and grouping requirements complete for unmatched,
  nested, and mixed scientific expressions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are keyboard and visible-control requirements both defined for
  every supported scientific function? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are initial state, active expression, result, and error state
  requirements documented for the scientific calculator? [Completeness,
  Spec §Key Entities]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 - Is “12 significant digits” defined consistently for ordinary,
  decimal, very large, and very small results? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is the exact set of typed function names explicitly specified,
  including capitalization and aliases? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the factorial syntax unambiguously limited to postfix `!`
  with a stated relationship to scientific keypad controls? [Clarity,
  Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the meaning of degree and radian angle modes defined for both
  direct and inverse trigonometric operations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are error categories distinguished with sufficiently specific
  wording to avoid ambiguous operation failures? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 - Do degree-mode requirements align across direct trigonometry,
  inverse trigonometry, and angle-mode switching? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are expression-entry requirements consistent between typed
  expressions and scientific keypad controls? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK013 - Does the scientific feature preserve the existing full-equation
  display behavior until evaluation consistently across all function entries?
  [Consistency, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are finite-result, overflow, and domain-error requirements
  consistent with the success criteria and data-model assumptions?
  [Consistency, Spec §FR-010–FR-12]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are scientific out-of-scope exclusions consistent with the
  supported-function requirements? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 - Can the grouped-expression acceptance criterion be verified
  without relying on implementation-specific behavior? [Acceptance Criteria,
  Spec §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is the 12-significant-digit reference criterion defined with an
  explicit comparison tolerance or independent expected-value method?
  [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the 45-second user-completion criterion defined with a sample
  task and participant conditions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is the 95% first-time completion criterion associated with
  explicit primary and alternate tasks? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are angle-mode success criteria measurable enough to distinguish
  degree and radian results objectively? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 - Are malformed-expression requirements defined for missing
  parentheses, unmatched parentheses, unsupported tokens, and incomplete input?
  [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are domain-invalid conditions specified for negative square roots,
  invalid logarithms, inverse-trigonometric ranges, and tangent undefined angles?
  [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are negative, non-integer, and overflow-factorial cases assigned
  clear requirements rather than remaining unspecified? [Coverage, Edge Case,
  Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are recovery requirements defined for transitioning from a
  scientific error to clear or replacement input? [Coverage, Recovery,
  Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are precedence and associativity requirements sufficiently
  defined for mixed arithmetic, powers, functions, and postfix factorial?
  [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are very-large and very-small finite-result requirements defined
  with readable scientific-notation boundaries? [Coverage, Edge Case,
  Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional and Interaction Requirements

- [ ] CHK027 - Are accessibility requirements defined for scientific buttons,
  angle-mode indicators, live expression feedback, and keyboard focus?
  [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are responsive-layout requirements specified for expanding the
  keypad to include scientific controls? [Gap, Assumption]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are performance requirements measurable for expression entry,
  evaluation, and display update rather than only general response time?
  [Clarity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are privacy and persistence requirements explicit for in-memory
  scientific expressions and angle mode? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities and Traceability

- [ ] CHK031 - Is the `Angle Mode` entity definition complete enough to resolve
  default, switching, persistence, and recalculation semantics? [Ambiguity,
  Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK032 - Are assumption boundaries for hyperbolic functions, complex
  numbers, matrices, statistics, and graphing explicit exclusions or deferred
  capabilities? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK033 - Are requirement IDs and acceptance criteria uniquely traceable
  across the specification, planned contracts, and future implementation tasks?
  [Traceability, Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion
  is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification or correction.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle.
- Add comments or findings inline.
